ValidationRule.description: Status cannot be Approved when Visits Approved and Precertification Start Date Precertification End Date are null
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Approved"), OR( ISBLANK( Visits_Approved__c ) , ISBLANK( Precertification_Start_Date__c ) , ISBLANK( Precertification_End_Date__c ) ), OR( ISPICKVAL( Type__c , "PT Precertification") , ISPICKVAL( Type__c , "OT Precertification") , ISPICKVAL( Type__c , "Chiro Precertification") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This record cannot be set to Approved if Visits Approved OR Precertification Start Date OR Precertification End Date are null
